text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're running next week, then... 
at long distance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes... it is outside my distance aptitude. 
According to my analysis, the win rate is 
under 30%.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have not yet achieved complete 
optimization...

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She wins~~!! With this, the Classic 
Double Crown! A magnificent run, giving 
every fiber of her body and soul!!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do to win?

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: ... In that case, take this with you.

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text: Everything is written in there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This is... Father's diary?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Month X, Day Y: Stamina reinforcement is 
an urgent priority. Even so... Bourbon can 
overcome it. Her passion toward her goal 
is this child's greatest talent"...!

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Haah... haah... haah...!"

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong? You still have 1 lap left. 
10 straight laps at top speed. This is an 
objective you must clear no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Standing still won't bring your goal any 
closer. It will only make the Triple 
Crown... drift further away."

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "The Triple Crown... drifting away..."

text_block_list.name: Young Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "Ugh... AAAAAHHHHHH—!!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Father—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Order: "Victory". Step 1: "Return to the 
dormitory while maintaining top speed".

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Engaging!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the centerpiece of today's 
fan meeting: the Special Match! Who will 
conquer this grueling 3000m journey!?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Let's take a look at the horse girls who 
have stepped up to this tough challenge.

text_block_list.name: Expert Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Stamina has long been considered Mihono 
Bourbon's biggest weakness. The question 
is whether she can overturn that 
assessment today...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(3000m... a distance deemed reckless for 
my body type.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(In terms of natural aptitude, I am 
lacking. That barrier is exceedingly 
high—)
(Woooooooaaaaahhhhh—!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
One by one, the horse girls enter the 
gates! The roaring passion of the crowd 
can be felt all the way over here!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(An inefficient choice. An unrealistic 
objective.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (Overcoming the pain—)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(With my own will, I will reach that dream 
from that day—)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
All horse girls are in the gates— And 
they're off!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (I will reach it!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon sets a blazing pace from 
the start! Is she planning to run this 
whole 3000m race completely solo?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: More! More!! MORE!!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Her legs aren't faltering at all! Mihono 
Bourbon! Leading wire-to-wire, she claims 
1st place!
(WAAAAAAAHHHHH!!!!)

Watching Mihono Bourbon run at that event 
made my heart tremble. On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Father... Yes. I won.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, I am not satisfied. I should have 
run a much stronger race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will retrain from scratch. All to grasp 
that aspiration.

Seeing Mihono Bourbon's stoic dedication, 
I felt a quiet sense of deep respect for 
her!
